scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm knip && pnpm sdk:check && pnpm docs:build && pnpm test:coverage
scripts.dev: node dev/env.ts && pnpm --filter directus-extension-geospatial build && docker compose --file dev/compose.yaml up --detach --wait && pnpm --filter directus-extension-geospatial dev
scripts.measure: pnpm --filter directus-extension-geospatial build && pnpm --filter directus-extension-geospatial-test-observer build && vitest run --project "measure:*" --no-file-parallelism
scripts.sdk:check: pnpm --filter directus-geospatial-sdk build && pnpm --filter directus-geospatial-sdk pack --out packages/sdk/directus-geospatial-sdk.tgz && publint --strict packages/sdk/directus-geospatial-sdk.tgz && attw packages/sdk/directus-geospatial-sdk.tgz
scripts.test:coverage: vitest run --project "unit*" --coverage && pnpm test:integration && node test/coverage.ts && node test/ratchet.ts
scripts.test:integration: pnpm --filter directus-extension-geospatial build --no-minify --sourcemap && pnpm --filter directus-extension-geospatial-test-hook build && pnpm --filter directus-extension-geospatial-test-observer build && vitest run --project "integration:*"
scripts.typecheck: tsc && tsc -p packages/contract && tsc -p packages/extension && tsc -p packages/sdk && tsc -p packages/sdk/tsconfig.oldest.json && tsc -p packages/docs && tsc -p test/hook && tsc -p test/measure/observer
